Step: Register a shop-floor station as a Terminal Location
Expected Result: Location created with LocationTypeDefinition = Terminal (resolving to LocationType = Cell), parented under a Cell/WorkCenter/Area

Step: Set IP address, default Zebra printer, and scanner-availability attributes
Expected Result: Attributes stored as LocationAttribute entries on the Terminal definition; registry surfaces a HasPrinter validation flag

Precondition: A Terminal with no active child Printer
Expected Result: HasPrinter flag marks the terminal as missing a printer; every Terminal carries at least one active child Printer Location

Step: Open a Perspective session from the terminal's IP
Expected Result: Gateway resolver returns terminal identity, parent zone, and DefaultScreen (Terminal_GetByIpAddress) — no mode carried

Precondition: A station whose IP is not registered
Step: Open a session from the unregistered IP
Expected Result: Terminal Selector gate appears (fallback context = whole Facility, subtitle 'Madison Facility'); operator picks the terminal from the plant tree

Precondition: A terminal running a dedicated-flavor view
Expected Result: Location context is fixed to the Terminal's parent Location (Cell/Line/Area); no selector shown; events carry both TerminalLocationId and LocationId

Precondition: A terminal running a shared-flavor view (Die Cast cabin)
Step: Start a session and pick the press
Expected Result: Operator selects context by scan or dropdown from the terminal-parent's descendant equipment Cells (Terminal_ListContextCells); chosen LocationId applies to subsequent events

Precondition: A shared-flavor terminal with a context selected
Step: Change the cell context by scan or dropdown
Expected Result: New LocationId applies to all subsequent events until changed again

Precondition: Two terminals with different DefaultScreen assignments
Step: Compare a dedicated-flavor and a shared-flavor terminal
Expected Result: Dedicated-vs-shared behavior follows the assigned operator view (DefaultScreen); no TerminalMode attribute exists; session.custom.presence.policy is set on load

Step: Attach a Terminal under a tier and assign its DefaultScreen
Expected Result: Terminal can be parented at Cell/WorkCenter/Area; behavior follows the assigned view from the MPP per-workstation list

Step: Attempt to change the cell context
Expected Result: No scan/dropdown/search is offered; the parent Location is the fixed context for the session
Change is allowed only via scan-or-dropdown, constrained to descendant equipment Cells of the terminal's parent (prevents cross-machine misattribution)

Precondition: A LOT being scanned into a cell
Step: Scan a LOT whose Item has direct ItemLocation eligibility at the cell or an ancestor tier

Precondition: A component LOT at an assembly cell
Step: Scan a LOT that is a child line of an eligible parent's active BOM
Expected Result: Scan-in passes via BOM-derived eligibility (no explicit ItemLocation row required)

Precondition: A LOT with neither direct nor BOM-derived eligibility
Step: Scan the LOT into the cell
Expected Result: Rejected: 'Part {PartNumber} is not configured for {CellCode} and is not a component of any part eligible there.'

Step: Operate the Die Cast screens on the tablet
Expected Result: Layout is touch-friendly (targets >= 44 px, portrait supported) and usable one-handed where practical
